/* eslint-disable no-underscore-dangle */ class API { /** * get and cache config object * @return object */ static getConfig() { if (API.configCache == null) { API.configCache = $.get("serve_config.json"); } return API.configCache; } static getCalendar() { return $.get("serve_main_calendar.json"); } static getPapers(url) { if (API.paperCache == null) { API.paperCache = $.get(url).then(d_raw => { const non_posters = {}; d_raw.results.filter(d => d.eventtype !== "Poster") .forEach(d => non_posters[d.id] = d) return d_raw.results.filter(d => d.eventtype === "Poster").map(d => { const emed = d.eventmedia .filter(em => em.detailed_kind == "thumb" && em.resourcetype === 'EventmediaImageFile')[0] const thumbnail = emed ? emed.file : ''; const sessions = [{ name: d.session, starttime: d.starttime, room: d.room_name }]; const reIDs = d.related_events_ids; const extra_session_count = reIDs.length; if (reIDs && extra_session_count > 0) { reIDs.forEach(id => { const special_event = non_posters[id]; if (special_event) { sessions.push({ name: special_event.session, starttime: special_event.starttime, room: special_event.room_name }); } }); } return { id: d.id, UID: d.uid, url: d.virtualsite_url, title: d.name, authors: d.authors.map(a => a.fullname), keywords: d.keywords, topic: d.topic, eventtype: d.eventtype, starttime: d.starttime, endtime: d.endtime, poster_position: d.poster_position, sessions, paper_pdf_url: d.paper_pdf_url, paper_thumbnail: thumbnail, has_thumbnail: !!emed, extra_session_count, abstract: d.abstract }; }); }); } return API.paperCache; } /** * Lazily load and cache the abstracts map ({event_id: "abstract", ...}). * Abstracts are split out of the main orals-posters JSON to keep it small; * they are only fetched on demand (detail layout / visualization page). * @param url * @return {Promise
